_meta.global_negatives: no buttons unless explicitly required by the style, no hashtag rendered in image, no AI-generated uncanny faces, no plastic skin texture, no malformed hands, no extra fingers, no AI-generated stock photo aesthetic, no generic SaaS template look, no rainbow colors, no over-saturated gradients, no watermarks, no Adobe Stock or Shutterstock vibe
_meta.design_principles: Every image must look like the deliberate work of a senior human graphic designer — editorial restraint, intentional palette of 2-3 colors per image, specific real-world lighting (lens, surface, materials named), confident typography. The viewer should NOT be able to tell an AI generated it.

Above the illustration a bold {text_color} sans-serif headline reads '{HEADLINE}' in {n_lines} lines, large legible crisp typography with tight kerning. {subline_block} Below illustration a tiny line of text reads 'Yammbo {service}' and 'yammbo.com'. Editorial product illustration style with restrained palette (max 3 colors plus background). Critical: any device screens visible (laptop, tablet, smartphone) must show only an abstract soft glow or blurred content; do NOT render readable UI text, app icons, buttons, or interface elements inside any screen. AVOID: AI-generated artifacts, generic SaaS template look, rainbow colors, melted shapes, uncanny perspective.

saas_hero_shot.prompt_template: Square 1:1 SaaS landing-page hero shot graphic. Left half of the frame: solid {bg}. Right half: clean pale off-white background.
